notes.title: EA Version 2.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Game Update Notes:
We are very excited to share the latest game update with you. Here are all the new features and improvements in this update:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mailbox: An in-game mailbox feature has been added. Future in-game rewards will be sent via the mailbox.
[*] Dedicated Map Contest Tab: A dedicated tab designed specifically for the map contest allows participants to find contest maps more quickly.
[/list]

[b]Map Editor Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Faster Map Loading Speed: We have optimized the game, significantly reducing map loading times.
[*] Map Time Limits: Creators can now set time limits for each maps.
[*] Map Statistics: Players can now view the number of plays and completion rates for maps, making it easier to judge difficulty and popularity.
[*] "My Maps" Tab Split: Maps are now split into "Published" and "Drafts".
[*] Three New Map Themes: City, Highland, and Space Station themes have been added to give your maps more character!
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Slide Sldier and Spike Descender (Large, Medium, Small): We've updated the design for both items. Now both items will provide more indication of when they will activate, which has reduced their difficulty.
[*] Cubs Enlarger and Cubs Shrinker: The Enlarger now only enlarges the Cubs (without stunning), and the Shinker now only shrinks the player (without continuous shrinking/enlarging). Both have updated designs.
[/list]

[b]System Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Login System: Steam login is now supported, simplifying the game access process.
[/list]

We are constantly seeking to improve your experience and appreciate all the feedback from our community. Come explore the new features and improvements!
